controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:02:22.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:02:22.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| STATS events     = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY rule      = falco.rule,
           proc      = falco.output_fields.proc.name,
           parent    = falco.output_fields.proc.pname,
           cmdline   = falco.output_fields.proc.cmdline,
           container = falco.output_fields.container.id,
           user      = falco.output_fields.user.name
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 100
